Today I mainly want to get the big picture and some first requirements down."},{"id":"M1:T2","text":"Good to see everyone. Did everybody survive the Monday?"},{"id":"M1:T3","text":"So, quick background. What we want is a product that enables CDN peering, so distinct CDNs can internetwork and deliver content in a coordinated, cooperative way. That lets providers scale out quickly, both for flash crowds and for demand increases they can see coming, and no single CDN has to provision all the resources itself. Whether the peering is ad-hoc or planned, there's fundamental research needed on the core problems: measuring and disseminating load information, request assignment and redirection, content replication, and working out fair compensation among participants, all at a geographically distributed Internet scale. In a single CDN those issues are deeply interrelated and depend on each other. The main thrust here is to handle them in a coordinated, cooperative way across many peered CDNs, while still satisfying the complex multi-dimensional constraints each individual provider has."},{"id":"M1:T4","text":"Thanks. Let's talk about triggers. It sounds like a fair bit of effort for something that's not top priority."},{"id":"M1:T18","text":"I'd keep it. It matters to us, and I don't want it dropped."},{"id":"M1:T19","text":"Let's leave that open for now and decide it later, once we've seen the rest."},{"id":"M1:T20","text":"Going back to triggers for a moment, is there anything else that should trigger something we haven't covered?"}]}
